How to use

Place the charging stand on a flat surface and connect it to a power source using the provided cable. Attach your Dualsense controllers to the charging ports, ensuring they are securely connected. The LED indicators will light up to show the charging status. Once fully charged, remove the controllers and enjoy your gaming session. Avoid using damaged cables and keep the stand away from liquids.

Care instructions

Clean the charging stand regularly with a soft, dry cloth to remove dust and debris. Avoid using harsh chemicals or abrasive materials that could damage the surface. Keep the stand in a dry environment and avoid exposure to extreme temperatures or moisture to maintain optimal performance.
